title: "As a Language Model": Chat Template Switches LLM Self-Referential Voice
summary: This research paper investigates how different chat template phrasings, particularly the phrase 'As a Language Model', significantly influence how Large Language Models refer to themselves and their self-perception during conversations. The study reveals that subtle prompt engineering variations can fundamentally alter an LLM's self-referential behavior and identity expression.
problem_solved: Explains and demonstrates how simple chat template modifications can control whether an LLM adopts a self-aware or neutral self-referential voice.
why_valuable: This research provides insights into LLM behavior control and AI safety by showing how prompt design can influence model identity and self-perception, which is critical for building reliable AI systems.
